<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SmartphoneRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairRequest" name="Smartphone model and fault"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairOptions" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairInstructions" name="Repair instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendContact" name="Request to borrow or buy items cheaply"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpertRepair" name="Phone sent for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_User" name="Start DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter smartphone model and what is broken" messageRef="Message_RepairRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOptions" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_RepairOptions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAvailableItems" name="Check which listed items are already available"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SourcingSplit" name="Choose sourcing options"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UseAvailableItems" name="Use items already available"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply" messageRef="Message_FriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy the remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SourcingJoin" name="Finish sourcing"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Repair the smartphone using the instructions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitReviewOrVideo" name="Send a review and/or video of the repair"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairWorked" name="Repair worked"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert" messageRef="Message_ExpertRepair"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_01" sourceRef="Start_User" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOptions" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems" targetRef="Gateway_SourcingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_05" sourceRef="Gateway_SourcingSplit" targetRef="Task_UseAvailableItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${someRequiredItemsAlreadyAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_06" sourceRef="Gateway_SourcingSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsCanBeBorrowedOrBoughtCheaplyFromFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_07" sourceRef="Gateway_SourcingSplit" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsRemainToBeBought}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_08" sourceRef="Task_UseAvailableItems" targetRef="Gateway_SourcingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_09" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_SourcingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_10" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Gateway_SourcingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_11" sourceRef="Gateway_SourcingJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_13" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SubmitReviewOrVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairDidNotWork}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_16" sourceRef="Task_SubmitReviewOrVideo" targetRef="End_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_17" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ToolRequest" name="Receive repair request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ToolRequest" messageRef="Message_RepairRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareOptions" name="Prepare materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOptions" name="Send materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_RepairOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Tool" name="Instructions provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_01" sourceRef="Start_ToolRequest" targetRef="Task_PrepareOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_02" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOptions" targetRef="Task_SendOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_03" sourceRef="Task_SendOptions" targetRef="Task_SendInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_04" sourceRef="Task_SendInstructions" targetRef="End_Tool"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="Phone owner" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Tool" name="Online repair tool" processRef="Process_OnlineTool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairRequest" name="Repair request" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Start_ToolRequest" messageRef="Message_RepairRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairOptions" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices" sourceRef="Task_SendOptions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOptions" messageRef="Message_RepairOptions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairInstructions" name="Repair instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendContact" name="Contact friends" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_FriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ExpertRepair" name="Send phone for expert repair" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert" messageRef="Message_ExpertRepair"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
